title: Add destination_v15: raise the speed level only after 10 updates without a fall
summary: destination_v15 is destination_v14 that raises the curriculum level only when no robot fell during the 10 updates it judges. Surrogate checkpoints of destination_v14 taken at the 0.125 and 0.15 m/s levels fell within about 2 s in most directions; the back-off is unchanged.
next: Train destination_v15 from the v9 checkpoint on the surrogate and test it against v9 at 0.05 to 0.15 m/s.
reason: A named experiment that no gate or registry entry uses yet; the canonical task and reward are unchanged.
